[[Promise of the Unseen]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[White Mantle Ritualist (ritualist)|White Mantle Ritualist]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]

**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]

**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
